capabilities: Opens .eml files from the file explorer in a dedicated view
Parses From, To, Cc, Bcc, Subject, Date, Message-ID, In-Reply-To, and References headers
Shows Text, sanitized HTML, and Raw MIME body tabs
Lists attachment metadata only: filename, content type, size, disposition
Searches headers, body text, sanitized HTML text, and attachment names
disambiguation: Not an email client; it only opens local .eml files read-only, with no sync, sending, remote images, or attachment opening.
extras: Explicit privacy model: no network APIs, no mailbox sync, no remote image loading, no scripts in HTML preview. v0.1 limits: attachments are metadata-only, render caps apply to large bodies, and Raw MIME stays available when parsing is incomplete.
intentEvidence: The existing community plugin Email Reader renders embedded .eml files in preview mode. EML Email Viewer is positioned differently
problem: Obsidian cannot open .eml email files, so headers, body text, and attachment details are inaccessible without an external mail client.

relations.evidence: The existing community plugin Email Reader renders embedded .eml files in preview mode.

summary: Read-only viewer that opens local .eml files in Obsidian with parsed headers, sanitized body previews, attachment metadata, and raw MIME source.
